findings: Original gnss->designMatrix is unconditionally executed. Cache replaces only the pure dynamic interpolation subexpression; per-observation matMult, column registration, original group/epoch QR, constraints and segmented observation export remain.

One Matrix entry per template instantiation is usable only in an active QR build generation. Fresh build generation invalidates fork-inherited entries, exception unwinding clears active state, outside-build recovery and parameter updates cannot reuse the entry.

Key retains owner/polynomial/design identity, receiver, epoch, arc, integer day, exact represented fractional day and long-double sub-Time remainder including signed zero, and arithmetic audit mode. Nonfinite keys and failed interpolation computations are never cached.
Inspected native Matrix copy implementation makes an independent value copy. Cache reuse does not alias the original matrix or downstream output columns.

Both ordinary and accumulateEpochObservations build paths initialize design bookkeeping and execute the original per-observation design. Eight prepared jobs cover two methods, both accumulation settings, both cache settings.

All eight XML trees reconstruct their older source trees exactly after reversing eight output/tmp/prefix remaps and removing the sole selected accumulation processing step. All explicit input XML and all 177-file input ledgers per job remain identical; outputs are fresh, isolated and disjoint from inputs.

Bounded runner keeps every planned attempt, freezes exact binary/build/runner/supervisor/Python identities, rechecks inputs before and after each fit, uses CPU0 and six numerical thread variables set to one, supervises 8GiB and7200s, and stops on unverified owned cleanup.
Instrumentation reports nested wall-time separately from child CPU and does not add these overlapping measures. It labels final linearization and parent solves/recovery/update as unmeasured.
limitations: Actual numerical equivalence, cache-hit coverage and timing remain untested by this static review; compare identical per-pair row/factor data, objective/acceptance/prior/support/signature, nuisance state, covariance and exports, and preserve failures.
Focused compiled author probe uses simplified return values and import stubs. The scheduled actual GNSS State pairs are necessary; no inference of whole-arc release readiness.

Older one-hour fixtures use historical physical inputs and nonzero full priors. Same new executable cache-off versus cache-on is an engineering comparison; it cannot replace corrected-v3.1 suite or frozen v4 attempts.
Initial admission is cooperative local process screening, not an exclusive reserved CPU claim; run serially only after the separate local build finishes.
Runner build manifest is produced by root-owned build and will be frozen at launch. Successful build plus identity checks are prerequisites to executing the reviewed source.
scope: Independent source, generated-patch and paired-fixture/control review; no native command or compiled test executed by this reviewer. Author nine-test result inspected and attributed separately.
